edits.before: Trade autos behind the roar sustain — the cow chips politely until level 2 changes religions.
edits.after: Zilean's Q double-bomb stuns your walk-up and E kites you before you find an engage.

edits.before: Full kit: headbutt-pulverize the carry off any wave state; trample the disengage.
edits.after: You bait his single Q, then freely W-Q flash the carry — he has nothing to peel.

edits.before: Zone with combo threat — their carry farms at the range your W defines.
edits.after: Your engage windows widen every time his Q is down, and he has no backup CC.

edits.before: Unbreakable Will online — tower dives become appointments; the cow ignores the counter-CC.
edits.after: Unbreakable Will dives past his revive — Chronoshift stops your kill, not your knockups.

edits.before: First item: the front line holds and the combos chain into jungler arrivals.
edits.after: First item your W-Q reliably reaches the carry past his lone Q stun.

edits.before: Late Alistar opens and survives: combo the carry, ult the focus, and trample the cleanup.
edits.after: Late you burst through Chronoshift by re-engaging — the revive buys time, not the lane.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Chronoshift (R) makes him untargetable to death for a few seconds — don't dump your whole combo into that revive window.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Spending your full combo the instant Chronoshift (R) pops — wait the revive out, then re-engage to finish it.

edits.before: - Zilean Chronoshift: matchup-defining — The revive undoes your kill — force it early or swap focus when it glows. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your R Unbreakable Will answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Zilean's Time Bomb (Q) is a 10s cooldown at rank 1 — force the double-bomb stun early and it's gone for the fight. - Your R Unbreakable Will answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.

notes: suspectNames flagged spikes[1].text 'Your Unbreakable Will' as a possible wrong ability name, but that's Alistar's own correctly-named R — false positive, left alone. Chart rewrite is grounded directly in content.whys, which was already accurate; only the full layer was stale.
